headline: Malaysian palm oil futures fall 1% on high stocks and weak demand
summary: Palm oil futures for February delivery on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange fell 1.1% to 4,387 ringgit per metric ton, pressured by high inventory levels and sluggish demand.
why: Malaysia is a leading producer of palm oil; price fluctuations impact agricultural commodity markets and the profitability of plantation companies.

impacts.name: Palm Oil
impacts.why: High stocks and weak demand directly lower prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
